thumbnail.generation_prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Create ONE finished 16:9 Korean gaming YouTube thumbnail, landscape 1536x864 or 1920x1080. Reference image is a genuine WARDOGS gameplay still: use its military industrial rooftop environment, muted green/brown modern tactical gear, and downed-player context as visual reference ONLY. This is a humorous cinematic promotional reconstruction of the video's repeated down-and-revive mishaps, not an exact gameplay screenshot. No UI, no copied existing captions.
Core scene: two modern tactical soldiers have BOTH fallen on a metal rooftop after a failed rescue. In the immediate foreground on the right, a middle-aged Korean male medic character, stocky ordinary middle-aged face, helmet and olive tactical vest, half-reclines awkwardly against a low rooftop barrier, looks directly toward viewer with confused, sheepish expression, one hand still holding a loose bandage roll. His other hand helplessly reaches outward. A second soldier is clearly lying down behind him, near his feet, also awaiting rescue; visually unmistakable two fallen teammates, no third standing rescuer. Medical pouch with a simple white plus on a green patch (not red cross). No blood or wounds. Humor and relatable incompetent beginner, not tragedy. Keep realistic game-render quality, not cartoon, no celebrity resemblance. Camera medium close and low, characters occupy lower/right 65%, shallow depth, rooftop and hills soft in background. Warm daylight, crisp readable silhouette, bright enough on mobile, subtle cinematic depth, restrained warm/cool contrast.
Typography is crucial. Render EXACTLY TWO Korean text blocks with these exact characters and NO other text:
Main headline: "나 메딕인데…?"
Secondary: "살리러 왔다가 같이 누움ㅋㅋ"
Main headline huge extra-bold Korean sans, white with thick dark outline, key word 메딕 in bright yellow. Across upper-left and upper-middle, safely inset 6% from all edges, single line if possible. Secondary smaller but strong bold white/yellow with dark outline on clean darker lower-left area, can split line between 왔다가 and 같이. All text must be legible at 320x180. Keep protagonist face and both downed figures visible. Avoid clutter, floating labels, speech bubbles, logos, fake killfeed, extra words, decorative arrows, borders. Do not include video title inside image. Deliver complete polished thumbnail with typography integrated in a single image.
